verses.geez:
ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ትእዛዝ ፡ ወፍትሕ ፡ ዘተዐቅቡ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትግበሩ ፡ በምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ ይሁበክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  አምላክክሙ ፡ መክፈልተክሙ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ዘተሐይዉ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.translation: And these are the ordinances and the judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the Lord God of your fathers gives you for an inheritance, all the days which ye live upon the land.

translations.lxx: And these are the ordinances and the judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the Lord God of your fathers gives you for an inheritance, all the days which ye live upon the land.
translations.kjv: These are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.
translations.ron: "Iată hotărârile şi legile pe care trebuie să vă siliţi a le împlini în pământul ce Domnul Dumnezeul părinţilor voştri vi-l dă în stăpânire, în toate zilele cît veţi trăi în pământul acela.
translations.grk: Καὶ ταῦτα τὰ προστάγματα καὶ αἱ κρίσεις, ἃς φυλάξετε τοῦ ποιεῖν ἐν τῇ γῇ, ἣν Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν δίδωσιν ὑμῖν ἐν κλήρῳ, πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας, ἃς ὑμεῖς ζῆτε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez:
ወደምስሶ ፡ ደምስስዎ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ መካን ፡ ዘውስቴቱ ፡ አምለኩ ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ [ዘ]አንትሙ ፡ ትትወረስዎሙ ፡
                  በውስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ ነዋኅት ፡ ወበውስተ ፡ አውግር ፡ ወበታሕተ ፡ አእዋም ፡ ቈጻል ።
verses.translation: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places in which they served their gods, whose land ye inherit, on the high mountains and on the hills, and under the thick tree.

translations.lxx: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places in which they served their gods, whose land ye inherit, on the high mountains and on the hills, and under the thick tree.
translations.kjv: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:
translations.ron: Să pustiiţi toate locurile în care popoarele ce le veţi supune au slujit dumnezeilor lor, cele din munţii înalţi, cele de pe dealuri şi cele de sub orice copac umbros.
translations.grk: Ἀπωλίᾳ ἀπολεῖτε πάντας τοὺς τόπους ἐν οἷς ἐλάτρευσαν ἐκεῖ τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν, οὓς ὑμεῖς κληρονομεῖτε αὐτοὺς, ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων τῶν ὑψηλῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν θινῶν, καὶ ὑποκάτω δένδρου δασέος·

verses.geez:
ወንሥቱ ፡ ምሥዋዓቲሆሙ ፡ ወቀጥቅጡ ፡ ምስሊሆሙ ፡ ወግዝሙ ፡ አእዋሚሆሙ ፡ ወአውዕዩ ፡ በእሳት ፡ ግልፎ ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ ፡
                  ወደምስሱ ፡ አስማቲሆሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መካን ።
verses.translation: And ye shall destroy their altars, and break in pieces their pillars, and ye shall cut down their groves, and ye shall burn with fire the graven images of their gods, and ye shall abolish their name out of that place.

translations.lxx: And ye shall destroy their altars, and break in pieces their pillars, and ye shall cut down their groves, and ye shall burn with fire the graven images of their gods, and ye shall abolish their name out of that place.
translations.kjv: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.
translations.ron: Să dărâmaţi jertfelnicele lor, să stricaţi stâlpii lor, să arderi cu foc copacii lor, să sfărâmaţi idolii dumnezeilor lor şi să ştergeţi numele lor din locurile acelea.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατασκάψετε τοὺς βωμοὺς αὐτῶν, καὶ συντρίψετε τὰς στήλας αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰ ἄλση αὐτῶν ἐκκόψετε, καὶ τὰ γλυπτὰ τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν κατακαύσετε πυρί, καὶ ἀπολεῖτε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου.

verses.geez: ወ[ኢ]ትገብሩ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ።
verses.translation: Ye shall not do so to the Lord your God.

translations.lxx: Ye shall not do so to the Lord your God.
translations.kjv: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.
translations.ron: Iar Domnului Dumnezeului vostru să nu-I faceţi aşa;
translations.grk: Οὐ ποιήσετε οὕτω Κυρίῳ τῷ Θεῷ ὑμῶν.

verses.geez:
[ዘእንበለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መካን ፡ ዘኀረየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡] በአሐቲ ፡ እምነ ፡ አህጉሪክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሰመይ ፡ ስሙ ፡
                  በህየ ፤
verses.translation: But in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose in one of your cities to name his name there, and to be called upon, ye shall even seek him out and go thither.

translations.lxx: But in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose in one of your cities to name his name there, and to be called upon, ye shall even seek him out and go thither.
translations.kjv: But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:
translations.ron: Ci la locul pe care-l va alege Domnul Dumnezeul vostru din toate seminţiile voastre, ca să-Şi pună numele Său asupra lui, să veniţi să-l cercetaţi.
translations.grk: Ἀλλʼ ἢ εἰς τὸν τόπον, ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξηται Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου ἐν μιᾷ τῶν πόλεων ὑμῶν ἐπονομάσαι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐπικληθῆναι, καὶ ἐκζητήσετε καὶ ἐλεύσεσθε ἐκεῖ.

verses.geez:
ወትወስዱ ፡ መሥዋዕተክሙ ፡ ወቍርባነክሙ ፡ ወቀዳምያቲክሙ ፡ ወብፅዓቲክሙ ፡ ወዘበፈቃድክሙ ፡ ወዘበአሚንክሙ ፡ ወበኵረ ፡
                  አልህምቲክሙ ፡ ወዘአባግዒክሙ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall carry thither your whole-burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, and your first-fruits, and your vowed-offerings, and your freewill-offerings, and your offerings of thanksgiving, the first-born of your herds, and of your flocks.

translations.lxx: And ye shall carry thither your whole-burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, and your first-fruits, and your vowed-offerings, and your freewill-offerings, and your offerings of thanksgiving, the first-born of your herds, and of your flocks.
translations.kjv: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:
translations.ron: Acolo să aduceţi arderile de tot ale voastre şi jertfele voastre, zeciuielile voastre şi ridicarea mâinilor voastre, făgăduinţele voastre, prinoasele voastre cele de bună voie şi jertfele voastre de pace, pe întâii născuţi ai vitelor voastre mari şi ai vitelor voastre mici;
translations.grk: Καὶ οἴσετε ἐκεῖ τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα ὑμων, καὶ τὰ θυσιάσματα ὑμῶν, καὶ τὰς ἀπαρχὰς ὑμῶν, καὶ τὰς εὐχὰς ὑμῶν, καὶ τὰ ἐκούσια ὑμῶν, καὶ τὰς ὁμολογίας ὑμῶν, τὰ πρωτότοκα τῶν βοῶν ὑμῶν, καὶ τῶν προβάτων ὑμῶν.

verses.geez:
ወብልዑ ፡ በህየ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ ወተፈሥሑ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ዘውስቴቱ ፡ ወደይክሙ ፡ እዴክሙ ፡
                  አንትሙ ፡ ወ(በ)ቤትክሙኒ ፡ እስመ ፡ ባረከከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall eat there before the Lord your God, and ye shall rejoice in all the things on which ye shall lay your hand, ye and your houses, as the Lord your God has blessed you.

translations.lxx: And ye shall eat there before the Lord your God, and ye shall rejoice in all the things on which ye shall lay your hand, ye and your houses, as the Lord your God has blessed you.
translations.kjv: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.
translations.ron: Să mâncaţi acolo înaintea Domnului Dumnezeului vostru şi să vă veseliţi cu familiile voastre pentru toate câte au făcut mâinile voastre şi cu câte v-a binecuvântat Domnul Dumnezeul vostru.
translations.grk: Καὶ φάγεσθε ἐκεῖ ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑμῶν, καὶ εὐφρανθήσεσθε ἐπὶ πᾶσιν, οὗ ἐὰν ἐπιβάλητε τὴν χεῖρα ὑμεῖς, καὶ οἱ οἶκοι ὑμῶν, καθότι εὐλόγησέ σε Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου.

verses.geez: ወኢትግበሩ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘንሕነ ፡ ንገብር ፡ ዮም ፡ በዝየ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ዘአደሞ ፡ በቅድሜሁ ።
verses.translation: Ye shall not do altogether as we do here to-day, every man that which is pleasing in his own sight.

translations.lxx: Ye shall not do altogether as we do here to-day, every man that which is pleasing in his own sight.
translations.kjv: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.
translations.ron: Să nu faceţi aşa cum facem noi acum aici, adică ceea ce i se pare fiecăruia că este bine;
translations.grk: Οὐ ποιήσετε πάντα ὅσα ἡμεῖς ποιοῦμεν ὧδε σήμερον, ἕκαστος τὸ ἀρεστὸν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ·

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ ኢበጻሕክሙ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይእዜ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምዕራፊክሙ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ርስትክሙ ፡ ዘይሁበክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  አምላክክሙ ።
verses.translation: For hitherto ye have not arrived at the rest and the inheritance, which the Lord our God gives you.

translations.lxx: For hitherto ye have not arrived at the rest and the inheritance, which the Lord our God gives you.
translations.kjv: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.
translations.ron: Căci noi acum n-am intrat în locul odihnei şi în moştenirea pe care ji-o dă Domnul Dumnezeul tău;
translations.grk: Οὐ γὰρ ἥκατε ἕως τοῦ νῦν εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν, καὶ εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν, ἣν Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν δίδωσιν ὑμῖν.

verses.geez:
ወዕድዉ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ወንበሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ ያወርሰክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ ወያዐርፈክሙ ፡
                  እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ፀርክሙ ፡ እለ ፡ አውድክሙ ፡ ወትነብሩ ፡ ተአሚነክሙ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall go over Jordan, and shall dwell in the land, which the Lord our God takes as an inheritance for you; and he shall give you rest from all your enemies round about, and ye shall dwell safely.

translations.lxx: And ye shall go over Jordan, and shall dwell in the land, which the Lord our God takes as an inheritance for you; and he shall give you rest from all your enemies round about, and ye shall dwell safely.
translations.kjv: But when ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God giveth you to inherit, and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;
translations.ron: Ci când veţi trece Iordanul şi vă veţi aşeza în pământul ce vi-l dă Domnul Dumnezeul vostru moştenire, când El vă va linişti de toţi vrăjmaşii voştri, care vă înconjură, şi veţi trăi la adăpost de primejdii,
translations.grk: Καὶ διαβήσεσθε τὸν Ἰορδάνην, καὶ κατοικήσετε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, ἧς Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν κατακληρονομεῖ ὑμῖν, καὶ καταπαύσει ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν ὑμῶν τῶν κύκλῳ, καὶ κατοικήσετε μετὰ ἀσφαλείας.

verses.geez:
ወይኩን ፡ ዝክቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ዘኀርየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሰመይ ፡ ስሙ ፡ በህየ ፡ ትወስዱ ፡ ኵሎ ፡
                  ዘአነ ፡ እኤዝዘክሙ ፡ ዮም ፡ [መሥዋዕት]ክሙ ፡ ወቍርባንክሙ ፡ ወዓሥራቲክሙ ፡ ወቀዳምያተ ፡ እደዊክሙ ፡ ወሀብትክሙ ፡ ወኅሩየ
                  ፡ ኵሉ ፡ መባእክሙ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ዘበፃእክሙ ፡ ለአምላክክሙ ።
verses.translation: And there shall be a place which the Lord thy God shall choose for his name to be called there, thither shall ye bring all things that I order you to-day; your whole-burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the first-fruits of your hands, and every choice gift of yours, whatsoever ye shall vow to the Lord your God.

translations.lxx: And there shall be a place which the Lord thy God shall choose for his name to be called there, thither shall ye bring all things that I order you to-day; your whole-burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the first-fruits of your hands, and every choice gift of yours, whatsoever ye shall vow to the Lord your God.
translations.kjv: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD:
translations.ron: Atunci la locul pe care-l va alege Domnul Dumnezeul vostru, ca să-Şi pună numele asupra Lui, acolo să aduceţi tot ce v-am poruncit Eu astăzi: arderile de tot ale voastre, jertfele voastre, zeciuielile voastre, ridicarea mâinilor voastre şi toate cele alese după făgăduinţele voastre, ce aţi făgăduit Domnului Dumnezeului vostru.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ὁ τόπος, ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξηται Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου ἐπικληθῆναι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ, ἐκεῖ οἴσετε πάντα ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν σήμερον· τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα ὑμῶν, καὶ τὰ θυσιάσματα ὑμῶν, καὶ τὰ ἐπιδέκατα ὑμῶν, καὶ τὰς ἀπαρχὰς τῶν χειρῶν ὑμῶν, καὶ πᾶν ἐκλεκτὸν τῶν δώρων ὑμῶν, ὅσα ἂν εὔξησθε Κυρίῳ τῷ Θεῷ ὑμῶν.

verses.geez:
ወተፈሥሑ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ወደቂቅክሙ ፡ ወአዋልዲክሙ ፡ ወአግብርቲክሙ ፡ ወአእማቲክሙ ፡
                  ወሌዋውያን ፡ እለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አንቀጽክሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ክፍለ ፡ ወርስተ ፡ ምስሌክሙ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall rejoice before the Lord your God, ye and your sons, and your daughters, and your men-servants and your maid-servants, and the Levite that is at your gates; because he has no portion or inheritance with you.

translations.lxx: And ye shall rejoice before the Lord your God, ye and your sons, and your daughters, and your men-servants and your maid-servants, and the Levite that is at your gates; because he has no portion or inheritance with you.
translations.kjv: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.
translations.ron: Să vă veseliţi înaintea Domnului Dumnezeului vostru, voi, fiii voştri şi fiicele voastre, robii voştri, roabele voastre şi levitul cel din mijlocul sălaşurilor voastre, că acela n-are parte şi moştenire cu voi.
translations.grk: Καὶ εὐφρανθήσεσθε ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑμῶν, ὑμεῖς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν, καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες ὑμῶν, καὶ οἱ παῖδες ὑμῶν, καὶ αἱ παιδίσκαι ὑμῶν, καὶ ὁ Λευίτης ὁ ἐπὶ τῶν πυλῶν ὑμῶν· ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτῷ μερὶς οὐδὲ κλῆρος μεθʼ ὑμῶν.

verses.geez: ወዑቅ ፡ ርእሰከ ፡ ኢትግበር ፡ መሥዋዕተከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መካን ፡ በኀበ ፡ ርኢከ ።
verses.translation: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy whole-burnt-offerings in any place which thou shalt see;

translations.lxx: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy whole-burnt-offerings in any place which thou shalt see;
translations.kjv: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:
translations.ron: Fereşte-te de a-ţi aduce arderile de tot ale tale în orice loc s-ar întâmpla,
translations.grk: Πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ, μὴ ἀνενέγκῃς τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματά σου ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ οὗ ἐὰν ἴδῃς.

verses.geez:
እንበለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መካን ፡ ዘኀርየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሕዘቢከ ፡ ህየ ፡ ትገብር
                  ፡ መሥዋዕተከ ፡ ወህየ ፡ ትገብር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአነ ፡ እኤዝዘከ ፡ ዮም ።
verses.translation: save in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose, in one of thy tribes, there shall ye offer your whole-burnt-offerings, and there shalt thou do all things whatsoever I charge thee this day.

translations.lxx: save in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose, in one of thy tribes, there shall ye offer your whole-burnt-offerings, and there shalt thou do all things whatsoever I charge thee this day.
translations.kjv: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.
translations.ron: Ci numai în locul acela pe care-l va alege Domnul Dumnezeul tău în una din seminţiile tale, şi fă tot ce ţi-am poruncit eu astăzi.
translations.grk: Ἀλλʼ ἢ εἰς τὸν τόπον, ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξεται Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου αὐτὸν, ἐν μιᾷ τῶν φυλῶν σου, ἐκεῖ ἀνοίσετε τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα ὑμῶν, καὶ ἐκεῖ ποιήσεις πάντα ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον.

verses.geez:
ወእምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘፈተውከ ፡ ትጥባኅ ፡ በህየ ፡ ወብላዕ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ በከመ ፡ በረከቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እንተ ፡ ወሀበከ
                  ፡ በኵሉ ፡ አህጉር ፤ ዘርኩስኒ ፡ ወዘንጹሕኒ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ይብልዕዎ ፡ ከመ ፡ ወይጠል ፡ አው ፡ ከመ ፡ ሀየል ።
verses.translation: But thou shalt kill according to all thy desire, and shalt eat flesh according to the blessing of the Lord thy God, which he has given thee in every city; the unclean that is within thee and the clean shall eat it on equal terms, as the doe or the stag.

translations.lxx: But thou shalt kill according to all thy desire, and shalt eat flesh according to the blessing of the Lord thy God, which he has given thee in every city; the unclean that is within thee and the clean shall eat it on equal terms, as the doe or the stag.
translations.kjv: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.
translations.ron: Totuşi, când îţi va pofti sufletul, vei putea să junghii şi să mănânci carne oriunde vei trăi, după binecuvântarea pe care ţi-a dat-o Domnul Dumnezeul tău; cel ce va fi necurat şi cel ce va fi curat vor putea să mănânce carne, cum se mănâncă cea de căprioară şi cea de cerb.
translations.grk: Ἀλλʼ ἢ ἐν πάσῃ ἐπιθυμίᾳ σου θύσεις, καὶ φαγῇ κρέα κατὰ τὴν εὐλογίαν Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου, ἣν ἔδωκέ σοι ἐν πάσῃ πόλει· ὁ ἀκάθαρτος ἐν σοὶ καὶ ὁ καθαρὸς ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό φάγεται αὐτό, ὡς δορκάδα ἢ ἔλαφον.

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ ፡ ደመ ፡ ኢትብልዑ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ከዐውዎ ፡ ከመ ፡ ማይ ።
verses.translation: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it out on the ground as water.

translations.lxx: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it out on the ground as water.
translations.kjv: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.
translations.ron: Numai sânge să nu mâncaţi, ci să-l vărsaţi jos ca apa.
translations.grk: Πλὴν τὸ αἷμα οὐ φάγεσθε· ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐκχεεῖτε αὐτὸ, ὡς ὕδωρ.

verses.geez:
ወኢትክል ፡ በሊዖቶ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ አህጉሪከ ፡ ዐሥራተ ፡ ወይንከ ፡ ወእክልከ ፡ ወቅብእከ ፡ ወበኵረ ፡ አልህምቲከ ፡
                  ወዘአባግዒከ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ብፅዓቲክሙ ፡ ዘበፃእክሙ ፡ ወዘአሚኖትክሙ ፡ ወዘቀደምያተ ፡ እደዊክሙ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt not be able to eat in thy cities the tithe of thy corn, and of thy wine, and of thine oil, the first-born of thine herd and of thy flock, and all your vows as many as ye shall have vowed, and your thank-offerings, and the first-fruits of thine hands.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt not be able to eat in thy cities the tithe of thy corn, and of thy wine, and of thine oil, the first-born of thine herd and of thy flock, and all your vows as many as ye shall have vowed, and your thank-offerings, and the first-fruits of thine hands.
translations.kjv: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:
translations.ron: Tu nu vei putea să mănânci în sălaşurile tale zeciuiala de la pâinea ta, de la vinul tău şi de la untdelemnul tău, întâii născuţi ai vitelor tale mari şi ai vitelor tale mărunte, nici darurile tale de bună voie, pe care le-ai făgăduit, nici prinoasele tale cele de bună voie, nici cele ridicate ale mâinilor tale,
translations.grk: Οὐ δυνήσῃ φαγεῖν ἐν ταῖς πόλεσί σου τὸ ἐπιδέκατον τοῦ σίτου σου, καὶ τοῦ οἴνου σου, καὶ τοῦ ἐλαίου σου, τὰ πρωτότοκα τῶν βοῶν σου, καὶ τῶν προβάτων σαυ, καὶ πάσας τὰς εὐχὰς, ὅσας ἂν εὔξησθε, καὶ τὰς ὁμολογίας ὑμῶν, καὶ τὰς ἀπαρχὰς τῶν χειρῶν σου.

verses.geez:
በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ብላዖ ፡ በውእቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ዘኀርየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ አንተ ፡
                  ወደቂቅከ ፡ ወወለትከ ፡ ወገብርከ ፡ ወአመትከ ፡ ወግዩር ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ሀገርክሙ ፡ ወትትፌሣሕ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  አምላክከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ዘወደይከ ፡ ውስቴቱ ፡ እዴከ ።
verses.translation: But before the Lord thy God thou shalt eat it, in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose for himself, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, and the stranger that is within thy gates; and thou shalt rejoice before the Lord thy God, on whatsoever thou shalt lay thine hand.

translations.lxx: But before the Lord thy God thou shalt eat it, in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose for himself, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, and the stranger that is within thy gates; and thou shalt rejoice before the Lord thy God, on whatsoever thou shalt lay thine hand.
translations.kjv: But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.
translations.ron: Ci acestea să le mănânci înaintea Domnului Dumnezeului tău, în locul acela pe care-l va alege Domnul Dumnezeul tău, tu şi fiul tău, fiica ta, robul tău şi roaba ta, levitul şi străinul care este în locaşurile tale şi să te veseleşti înaintea Domnului Dumnezeului tău de toate câte au făcut mâinile tale.
translations.grk: Ἀλλʼ ἢ ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου φάγῃ αὐτὸ ἐν τῷ τόπῳ, ᾧ ἂν ἐκλέξηται Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου αὐτῷ, σὺ καὶ ὁ υἱός σου, καὶ ἡ θυγάτηρ σου, ὁ παῖς σου, καὶ ἡ παιδίσκη σου, καὶ ὁ προσήλυτος ὁ ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν ὑμῶν· καὶ εὐφρανθήσῃ ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου ἐπὶ πάντα, οὗ ἐὰν ἐπιβάλῃς τὴν χεῖρά σου.

verses.geez: ወዑቅ ፡ ርእሰከ ፡ ኢትኅድጎ ፡ ለሌዋዊ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ዘሕያው ፡ አንተ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.translation: Take heed to thyself that thou do not desert the Levite all the time that thou livest upon the earth.

translations.lxx: Take heed to thyself that thou do not desert the Levite all the time that thou livest upon the earth.
translations.kjv: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.
translations.ron: Bagă de seamă să nu părăseşti pe levit în toate zilele cît vei trăi în pământul tău.
translations.grk: Πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς τὸν Λευίτην πάντα τὸν χρόνον ὅσον ἂ ζῇς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez:
ወለእመኒ ፡ አርኀበ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ደወለከ ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤለከ ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ወትቤ ፡ እብላዕ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ለእመ
                  ፡ ፈተወት ፡ ነፍስከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትብላዕ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘፈተወት ፡ ነፍስከ ፡ ብላዕ ፡ ሥጋ ።
verses.translation: And if the Lord thy God shall enlarge thy borders, as he said to thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh; if thy soul should desire to eat flesh, thou shalt eat flesh according to all the desire of thy soul.

translations.lxx: And if the Lord thy God shall enlarge thy borders, as he said to thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh; if thy soul should desire to eat flesh, thou shalt eat flesh according to all the desire of thy soul.
translations.kjv: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
translations.ron: Când va lărgi Domnul Dumnezeul tău hotarele tale, precum ţi-a grăit El, şi vei zice: Voi mânca şi carne, pentru că sufletul tău doreşte să mănânce carne, mănâncă şi carne, după dorinţa sufletului tău.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ ἐμπλατύνῃ Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου τὰ ὅριά σου, καθάπερ ἐλάλησέ σοι, καὶ ἐρεῖς, φάγομαι κρέα, ἐὰν ἐπιθυμήσῃ ἡ ψυχή σου ὥστε φαγεῖν κρέα, ἐν πάσῃ ἐπιθυμίᾳ τῆς ψυχῆς σου φάγῃ κρέα.

verses.geez:
ወለእመሰ ፡ ርኁቅ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኀርየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሰመይ ፡ ስሙ ፡ በህየ ፡
                  ወትጠብኅ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አልህምቲከ ፡ ወአባግዒከ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ዘወሀበከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ በከመ ፡
                  አዘዝኩክሙ ፡ ወብላዕ ፡ በሀገርከ ፡ ዘፈተወት ፡ ነፍስከ ።
verses.translation: And if the place be far from thee, which the Lord thy God shall choose for himself, that his name be called upon it, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock which God shall have given thee, even as I commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy cities according to the desire of thy soul.

translations.lxx: And if the place be far from thee, which the Lord thy God shall choose for himself, that his name be called upon it, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock which God shall have given thee, even as I commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy cities according to the desire of thy soul.
translations.kjv: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
translations.ron: De va fi departe de tine locul pe care l-a ales Domnul Dumnezeul tău, ca să-Şi pună numele asupra lui, atunci să junghii din vitele tale mari şi mărunte pe care ţi le-a dat Domnul Dumnezeul tău, după cum ţi-am poruncit eu, şi să mănânci în locuinţele tale, după dorinţa sufletului tău.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ μακρὰν ἀπέχῃ σου ὁ τόπος, ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξηται Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου ἐκεῖ ἐπικληθῆναι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ, καὶ θύσεις ἀπὸ τῶν βοῶν σου, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν προβάτων σου ὧν ἂν δῷ ὁ Θεός σοι, ὃν τρόπον ἐνετειλάμην σοι, καὶ φαγῃ ἐν ταῖς πόλεσί σου κατὰ τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν τῆς ψυχῆς σου.

verses.geez: በከመ ፡ ትበልዑ ፡ ወይጠለ ፡ አው ፡ ሀየለ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ብላዖ ፤ ዘርኩስኒ ፡ እምኔከ ፡ ወዘንጹሕኒ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ብልዕዎ ።
verses.translation: As the doe and the stag are eaten, so shalt thou eat it; the unclean in thee and the clean shall eat it in like manner.

translations.lxx: As the doe and the stag are eaten, so shalt thou eat it; the unclean in thee and the clean shall eat it in like manner.
translations.kjv: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.
translations.ron: Dar să le mănânci cum se mănâncă cerbul şi căprioara; aceasta poate să mănânce şi cel curat şi cel necurat al tău.
translations.grk: Ὡς ἔσθεται ἡ δορκὰς καὶ ἡ ἔλαφος, οὕτω φαγῃ αὐτό· ὁ ἀκάθαρτος ἐν σοὶ καὶ ὁ καθαρὸς ὡσαύτως ἔδεται.

verses.geez: ወተዐቀብ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትብላዕ ፡ ደመ ፡ እስመ ፡ ደሙ ፡ ነፍሱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወኢይበልዑ ፡ ነፍሰ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሥጋ ።
verses.translation: Take diligent heed that thou eat no blood, for blood is the life of it; the life shall not be eaten with the flesh.

translations.lxx: Take diligent heed that thou eat no blood, for blood is the life of it; the life shall not be eaten with the flesh.
translations.kjv: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.
translations.ron: Dar ia bine seama să nu mănânci sânge, pentru că sângele are în el viaţă şi să nu mănânci viaţa laolaltă cu carnea.
translations.grk: Πρόσεχε ἰσχυρῶς τοῦ μὴ φαγεῖν αἷμα, ὅτι αἷμα αὐτοῦ ψυχή· οὐ βρωθήσεται ψυχὴ μετὰ τῶν κρεῶν.

verses.geez: ኢትብልዑ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ከዐውዎ ፡ ከመ ፡ ማይ ።
verses.translation: Ye shall not eat it; ye shall pour it out on the ground as water.

translations.lxx: Ye shall not eat it; ye shall pour it out on the ground as water.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.
translations.ron: Să nu mănânci sângele, ci să-l verşi jos ca apa.
translations.grk: Οὐ φάγεσθε· ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐκχεεῖτε αὐτὸ ὡς ὕδωρ.

verses.geez:
ወኢትብልዖ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሠናይት ፡ ትኩንከ ፡ ወለውሉድከኒ ፡ እምድኅሬከ ፡ (ወ)ለእመ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ ዘሠናይ ፡ ቅድመ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ወዘአዳም ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt not eat it, that it may be well with thee and with thy sons after thee, if thou shalt do that which is good and pleasing before the Lord thy God.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt not eat it, that it may be well with thee and with thy sons after thee, if thou shalt do that which is good and pleasing before the Lord thy God.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD.
translations.ron: Să nu-l mănânci, ca să-ţi fie bine în veci, ţie şi copiilor tăi de după tine, şi bine-ţi va fi de vei face cele bune şi cele plăcute înaintea ochilor Domnului Dumnezeului tău.
translations.grk: Οὐ φαγῇ αὐτὸ, ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς σου μετὰ σὲ, ἐὰν ποιήσῃς τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ ἀρεστὸν ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου.

verses.geez:
ወባሕቱ ፡ ዘረሰይከ ፡ ቅዱሰ ፡ ወዘበፃእከ ፡ ንሣእ ፡ ወሑር ፡ ውስተ ፡ መካን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኀርየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  አምላክከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሰመይ ፡ ስሙ ፡ በህየ ።
verses.translation: But thou shalt take thy holy things, if thou hast any, and thy vowed-offerings, and come to the place which the Lord thy God shall choose to have his name named upon it.

translations.lxx: But thou shalt take thy holy things, if thou hast any, and thy vowed-offerings, and come to the place which the Lord thy God shall choose to have his name named upon it.
translations.kjv: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose:
translations.ron: Dar cele închinate ale tale, câte le vei avea, şi cele făgăduite ale tale, ia-le şi vino la locul acela pe care 1-a ales Domnul Dumnezeul tău, ca să se cheme numele Lui acolo.
translations.grk: Πλὴν τὰ ἅγιά σου ἐὰν γένηταί σοι, καὶ τὰς εὐχάς σου λαβὼν ἥξεις εἰς τὸν τόπον, ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξηται Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου ἐπικληθῆναι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ.

verses.geez:
ወትገብር ፡ መሣውዒከ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ወትወዲ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወደሞሰ ፡ ለመሥዋዕትከ ፡ ትክዑ ፡ ኀበ ፡ መንበረ ፡
                  ምሥዋዕ ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ወብላዕ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሥጋሁ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt sacrifice thy whole-burnt-offerings, thou shalt offer the flesh upon the altar of the Lord thy God; but the blood of thy sacrifices thou shalt pour out at the foot of the altar of the Lord thy God, but the flesh thou shalt eat.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt sacrifice thy whole-burnt-offerings, thou shalt offer the flesh upon the altar of the Lord thy God; but the blood of thy sacrifices thou shalt pour out at the foot of the altar of the Lord thy God, but the flesh thou shalt eat.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.
translations.ron: Să săvârşeşti arderile de tot ale tale, carnea şi sângele, pe jertfelnicul Domnului Dumnezeului tău; sângele celorlalte jertfe ale tale să fie vărsat lângă jertfelnicul Domnului Dumnezeului tău, iar carnea lor s-o mănânci.
translations.grk: Καὶ ποιήσεις τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματά σου, τὰ κρέα ἀνοίσεις ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου· τὸ δὲ αἷμα τῶν θυσιῶν σου προσχεεῖς πρὸς τὴν βάσιν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου, τὰ δὲ κρέα φαγῇ.

verses.geez:
ወዕቂብ ፡ ወስማዕ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ዘአነ ፡ እኤዝዘከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ከመ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ይኩንከ ፡ ወለውሉድከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡
                  ለእመ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ ዘሠናይ ፡ ወዘአዳም ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ።
verses.translation: Beware and hearken, and thou shalt do all the commands which I charge thee, that it may be well with thee and with thy sons for ever, if thou shalt do that which is pleasing and good before the Lord thy God.

translations.lxx: Beware and hearken, and thou shalt do all the commands which I charge thee, that it may be well with thee and with thy sons for ever, if thou shalt do that which is pleasing and good before the Lord thy God.
translations.kjv: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.
translations.ron: Ascultă şi împlineşte toate poruncile acestea pe care ţi le dau eu astăzi, ca să-ţi fie bine în veci, ţie şi copiilor tăi şi bine-ţi va fi de vei face cele bune şi plăcute înaintea ochilor Domnului Dumnezeului tău.
translations.grk: Φυλάσσου καὶ ἄκουε καὶ ποιήσεις πάντας τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι, ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς σου διʼ αἰῶνος, ἐὰν ποιήσῃς τὸ ἀρεστὸν καὶ τὸ καλὸν ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου.

verses.geez:
ወለእመኒ ፡ አጥፍኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ እለ ፡ ትበውእ ፡ ህየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትትወረስዎሙ ፡ ምድሮሙ
                  ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጽከ ፡ ወትትዋረሶሙ ፡ ወትነብር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድሮሙ ፤
verses.translation: And if the Lord thy God shall utterly destroy the nations, to whom thou goest in thither to inherit their land, from before thee, and thou shalt inherit it, and dwell in their land;

translations.lxx: And if the Lord thy God shall utterly destroy the nations, to whom thou goest in thither to inherit their land, from before thee, and thou shalt inherit it, and dwell in their land;
translations.kjv: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;
translations.ron: Când Domnul Dumnezeul tău va pierde de la faţa ta popoarele la care mergi, ca să le cuprinzi, şi după ce le vei cuprinde şi te vei aşeza în pământul lor,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ ἐξολοθρεύσῃ Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου τὰ ἔθνη, εἰς οὓς εἰσπορεύῃ ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν, ἀπὸ προσώπου σου, καὶ κατακληρονομήσῃς αὐτὴν, καὶ κατοικήσῃς ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν,

verses.geez:
ዑቅ ፡ ርእሰከ ፡ ኢትፍቅድ ፡ ተሊዎቶሙ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ተሠረዉ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጽከ ፡ ወኢትፍቅድ ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ ፡
                  ወኢትበል ፡ ከመዘ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ለአማልክቲሆሙ ፡ እግበር ፡ አነኒ ።
verses.translation: take heed to thyself that thou seek not to follow them after they are destroyed before thee, saying, How do these nations act towards their gods? I will do likewise.

translations.lxx: take heed to thyself that thou seek not to follow them after they are destroyed before thee, saying, How do these nations act towards their gods? I will do likewise.
translations.kjv: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.
translations.ron: Atunci să te păzeşti ca să nu cazi în cursă şi să le urmezi lor, după ce le vei pierde de pe faţa pământului, şi să nu cauţi pe dumnezeii lor, zicând: Cum au slujit popoarele acestea dumnezeilor lor, aşa voi face şi eu.
translations.grk: πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ μὴ ἐκζητήσῃς ἐπακολουθῆσαι αὐτοῖς μετὰ τὸ ἐξολοθρευθῆναι αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ προσώπου σου, λέγων, πῶς ποιοῦσι τὰ ἔθνη ταῦτα τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν; ποιήσω κᾀγώ.

verses.geez:
ወኢትግበር ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ጸልአ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ርኩሰ ፡ ዘይገብሩ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡
                  ለአማልክቲሆሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ደቂቆሙ ፡ ወአዋልዲሆሙ ፡ ያውዕዩ ፡ በእሳት ፡ ለአማልክቲሆሙ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt not do so to thy God; for they have sacrificed to their gods the abominations of the Lord which he hates, for they burn their sons and their daughters in fire to their gods.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt not do so to thy God; for they have sacrificed to their gods the abominations of the Lord which he hates, for they burn their sons and their daughters in fire to their gods.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.
translations.ron: Să nu faci aşa Domnului Dumnezeului tău, căci aceia fac dumnezeilor lor toate de care se îndepărtează Domnul şi pe care le urăşte El; aceia şi pe fiii şi pe fiicele lor le ard pe foc înaintea dumnezeilor lor.
translations.grk: Οὐ ποιήσεις οὕτω τῷ Θεῷ σου· τὰ γὰρ βδελύματα Κυρίου ἃ ἐμίσησεν, ἐποίησαν ἐν τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν, ὅτι τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῶν κατακαίουσιν ἐν πυρὶ τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν.
